interpretation_limits: Only six paired seeds per fixture and a 300-tick horizon.
All V1 focal individuals died by tick 199; the candidate did not prevent eventual death.
The candidate flag was enabled only in the candidate arm; the feature remains default-off in the project.
The V1 zero-energy visible-food counters are budget-deficit diagnostics, not exclusive causal attribution.
No reserve interventions or physical differences occurred in meadow or sparse-resource; sparse populations still went extinct.
Plant food energy is gross intake, not net energy; metabolism, water depletion, and action costs remain separate.
No utility composite, general ecology qualification, or live acceptance is supported.
